## Design

### 2026-11-08: I completely forgot about this week until literally today which is the very last day however I just had a crazy lock in sesssion. I worked for seven hours on designing my schematic and pcb. I had 76 l

**7h**

I completely forgot about this week until literally today which is the very last day however I just had a crazy lock in sesssion. I worked for seven hours on designing my schematic and pcb. I had 76 lined which i needed to route which I'm pretty sure is the most I've every done. I researched how to design a custom audio  player and got to work. It took me a crazy long time to design and trouble shoot the schematic because I wasn't following any tutorials and I was researching different things that I need to do and fixing errors such as not having a resistor or capacitor and things like that. I also had to study what parts should connect where, when I should use a 3V3 vs a 3.3V, and other similar design rules. I also had to research what parts I need to use and what footprints. I then had to design my own new footprint for a capacitive touchpad inspired my the week 3 midi keyboard. A key diffference between this and the week 3 midi keyboard is that this will actually have a speaker. A specific example of an error I was trouble shooting is how to create a small boottime/flash time period so that to currents in the ESP-32 don't spike as much. Then I had to figure out where to wire every single pin and which pins don't need wiring. This took forever to do and then after that, I had to route 76, yes 76 lines in the pcb editor. This took a crazy long time to move everything around and arrange everything in a way that's intuitive to use while still being possible to route using only 2 layers.

### 2026-11-08: I started and finished the firmware and updated the schematic. I trouble shooted the firmware a lot and I had to test it against the ESP32-S3 Dev Module. I had to assign every single pin and code the

**4h**

I started and finished the firmware and updated the schematic. I trouble shooted the firmware a lot and I had to test it against the ESP32-S3 Dev Module. I had to assign every single pin and code the firmware accounting for the all the parts. I also had to make sure that there was enough storage for an MP3 File.
